Name: Black Jack farmer mod
Author: meloncolle
Description:
[url=https://tezukaosamu.net/en/manga/438.html]About Black Jack (tezukaosamu.net)[/url]﻿

This is my first time touching Stardew Valley mods, so I'm not sure what conflicts with other mods it may cause if any. Requires SMAPI + ContentPatcher, and tested only with SDV 1.6.

List of changes:
[list]
[*]Adds Black Jack's hairstyle (It appears at the end of the default hairstyles)

[*]Changes farmer base (male only) to add Black Jack's blue facial skin graft

[*]Replaces shirt #39 with Black Jack's dress shirt + bow (no jacket)

[/list]
This works best with skin tone #1, as I had to add some skin color to the right-facing hair sprite in order to cover up the skin graft so it properly appears asymmetrical.

Downloads.Description: Fixed missing skin graft on fishing sprite
